why: Fixes 'Huis? House': there are no Dutch words on screen, and every line is a full correct English sentence. The punch is cut to 6 words ('Zero food wasted in 21 days.'), with no hyphen chains. The quotes match in the text and the caption. Hashtags share only 2 tags (#fridgeroo, #budgettips) with Mon 19, and there is one Dutch tag. Lofi, berry and chill differ from C (tropical, lagoon, upbeat) and from Mon (phonk, mint, hype).
